profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this logistics and transportation provider specializes in freight forwarding and supply chain management, catering to the needs of businesses in the region. Its expertise in managing complex logistics operations has driven a 76.9% growth in employees, solidifying its position as a key player in the industry. As a Scaler, the company's focus on efficient transportation and storage solutions has enabled it to expand its services and meet the increasing demands of its clients.
